boards.title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
boards.description: Ten corridor stops around UC San Diego, each anchored to a named destination with a documented reason to go.

cards.title: La Jolla Village Drive: Westfield UTC
cards.subtitle: La Jolla Village Drive corridor
cards.notes: Use the mall’s access page to orient yourself at 4545 La Jolla Village Drive before choosing a shop, meal, or transit connection.
cards.short_summary: A documented retail-and-services destination on the main La Jolla Village Drive approach.
cards.evidence_claim: Westfield UTC lists its address as 4545 La Jolla Village Drive, San Diego.
cards.access_notes: Check individual tenants and the center’s access page before going.

cards.title: La Jolla Village Drive: La Jolla Playhouse
cards.subtitle: La Jolla Village Drive corridor
cards.notes: Check the production calendar, then use the Playhouse visitor information for the theatre address and its UC San Diego parking guidance.
cards.short_summary: A campus-edge theatre destination with current visitor and ticket information.
cards.evidence_claim: La Jolla Playhouse lists its address as 2910 La Jolla Village Drive and provides visitor planning information.
cards.source_title: La Jolla Playhouse — Plan Your Visit
cards.access_notes: Performances require tickets; UC San Diego parking rules apply.

cards.title: Expedition Way: Birch Aquarium
cards.subtitle: Expedition Way corridor
cards.notes: Plan around the aquarium’s daily schedule and arrive at its Expedition Way address; use its digital guide for ocean-science context.
cards.short_summary: A Scripps ocean-science destination with exhibits, talks, and animal feedings on the daily schedule.
cards.evidence_claim: Birch Aquarium is located at 2300 Expedition Way and publishes ticket, schedule, and parking information.
cards.source_title: Birch Aquarium at Scripps — Plan Your Visit
cards.access_notes: Admission is ticketed; daily closing times vary by season.

cards.title: North Torrey Pines Road: Torrey Pines State Natural Reserve
cards.subtitle: North Torrey Pines Road corridor
cards.notes: Choose a designated trail and stay on it; the reserve’s official page identifies hiking trails, a visitor center, and interpretive programs.
cards.short_summary: A protected coastal reserve for trail walking and interpretive exhibits.
cards.evidence_claim: The reserve is at 12600 N. Torrey Pines Road and features hiking trails, a visitor center, and interpretive programs.
cards.source_title: California State Parks — Torrey Pines State Natural Reserve
cards.access_notes: Gates open at 7:15 a.m. and close at sunset; follow posted reserve rules.

cards.title: Torrey Pines Scenic Drive: Torrey Pines Gliderport
cards.subtitle: Torrey Pines Scenic Drive corridor
cards.notes: Stop at the city-listed gliderport viewpoint and use the area as a documented Torrey Pines City Park landmark rather than an unmarked overlook.
cards.short_summary: A named city-park landmark on the coastal bluff corridor.
cards.evidence_claim: The City identifies Torrey Pines City Park at 2800 Torrey Pines Scenic Drive as the Torrey Pines Gliderport.
cards.source_title: City of San Diego — Torrey Pines City Park
cards.access_notes: Use established public areas and observe posted site rules.

cards.title: Regents Road: Doyle Community Park
cards.subtitle: Regents Road corridor
cards.notes: Meet at the city-listed community park on Regents Road, then use the recreation center contact information to confirm a program or facility plan.
cards.short_summary: A named municipal park and recreation-center stop in University City.
cards.evidence_claim: The City lists Doyle Community Park and Doyle Recreation Center at 8175 Regents Road.
cards.source_title: City of San Diego — University City Community Resources
cards.access_notes: Contact the recreation center for current program and facility details.

cards.title: Via Mallorca: Via La Jolla Park
cards.subtitle: Via Mallorca corridor
cards.notes: Use the City’s La Jolla community listing to locate this named park at Via Mallorca and Via Marin, then keep the visit to public park areas.
cards.short_summary: A city-listed park destination at the Via Mallorca and Via Marin corridor.
cards.evidence_claim: The City lists Via La Jolla Park at Via Mallorca and Via Marin in La Jolla.
cards.source_title: City of San Diego — La Jolla Community Resources
cards.access_notes: Observe posted park rules and any site-specific closures.

cards.entity_name: Museum of Contemporary Art San Diego, La Jolla
cards.title: Prospect Street: MCASD La Jolla
cards.subtitle: Prospect Street corridor
cards.notes: Check the current exhibitions and admission policy before visiting; the museum also lists recurring free-admission eligibility and select free days.
cards.short_summary: A Prospect Street museum stop for contemporary-art exhibitions and collection galleries.
cards.evidence_claim: MCASD La Jolla is at 700 Prospect Street and lists current exhibitions, hours, and admission information.
cards.source_title: Museum of Contemporary Art San Diego — Visit MCASD La Jolla
cards.access_notes: Hours and ticket availability vary; confirm the museum’s current visit page before departure.

cards.title: Coast Boulevard: La Jolla Cove
cards.subtitle: Coast Boulevard corridor
cards.notes: Use the city beach page to plan a daytime shoreline stop, follow lifeguard guidance, and respect the ecological-reserve restrictions on removing objects.
cards.short_summary: A city-managed cove with lifeguard service, shoreline amenities, and marine-reserve protections.
cards.evidence_claim: La Jolla Cove is a small beach within the La Jolla Underwater Park Ecological Reserve and has a permanent lifeguard station.
cards.source_title: City of San Diego — La Jolla Cove
cards.access_notes: No alcohol, glass, smoking, camping, dogs, fishing, or removal of objects; follow lifeguard directions.

cards.title: Genesee Avenue: Rose Canyon Open Space Park
cards.subtitle: Genesee Avenue corridor
cards.notes: Use the city’s trail-map page to choose an established route, and bring water while staying on marked public paths through the canyon habitats.
cards.short_summary: An open-space destination with a city-published trail map and varied Southern California habitats.
cards.evidence_claim: The City describes Rose Canyon Open Space Park as containing coastal sage scrub, chaparral, oak woodland, and rare riparian habitat.
cards.source_title: City of San Diego — Rose Canyon Open Space Park
cards.access_notes: Use posted trail information and city park rules; do not enter closed or undeveloped areas.
